t: What Preventive Screening Evidence Database Is All About
title: What Preventive Screening Evidence Database Is All About
description: Screening finds disease early in the well: mammography, colonoscopy, blood pressure checks. But screening has harms — overdiagnosis (finding cancers that would never matter), false positives, and anxiety. Wilson and Jungner's 1968 criteria still gatekeep: the condition must matter, have a detectable early stage, and treatment must beat late treatment. USPSTF grades A (do it) to D (don't) to I (insufficient evidence). This database is the complete screening evidence: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Preventive Screening Evidence Database: a complete reference database of full screening evidence records.
key_points: What this database holds: full screening evidence records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
